g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: D2: series cell diode (docs/standard.md section 3). Current can leave the cell, never enter it.

g.desc: D2: series cell diode (docs/standard.md section 3). Current can leave the cell, never enter it.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the light. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell through D2.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the light. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell through D2.

g.text: R2, R3: NorthSec's I2C pull-ups (1 k on the original). NOT FITTED by default: the SAO standard has the badge provide the pull-ups. Fit 1.3 k to get NorthSec's function.

g.desc: R2, R3: NorthSec's I2C pull-ups (1 k on the original). NOT FITTED by default: the SAO standard has the badge provide the pull-ups. Fit 1.3 k to get NorthSec's function.

g.text: If fitted they join SDA and SCL to the badge's own 3.3 V pin (VSAO), ahead of the switch, exactly as on the original: no path from them to the cell or to the light.

g.desc: If fitted they join SDA and SCL to the badge's own 3.3 V pin (VSAO), ahead of the switch, exactly as on the original: no path from them to the cell or to the light.

g.text: D1: red reverse-mount LED on the back, shining through the board in the middle of the gauze pad, where NorthSec's hand-soldered 1206 LED sat on the front.

g.desc: D1: red reverse-mount LED on the back, shining through the board in the middle of the gauze pad, where NorthSec's hand-soldered 1206 LED sat on the front.

g.text: R1 1.3k (the original used 330 ohm on 3.3 V): about 1.1 mA on badge power, about 0.6 mA on a fresh cell after D2.

g.desc: R1 1.3k (the original used 330 ohm on 3.3 V): about 1.1 mA on badge power, about 0.6 mA on a fresh cell after D2.
